items.headline: Trump: Iran par hamla 'highly unlikely'
items.detail: Trump ne CNN ko kaha — Iran se vaarta me pragati rahi to dobara hamla 'highly unlikely'; mazboot samjhote par nirbhar; saath hi chetavani di — 38 pulon samet lakshya tay hain, teen vimanvahak taiyaar; Iran ke videsh mantri ne vaarta ruki rehne ki baat kahi.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran parmanu vaarta aur Hormuz — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nvidia: CEO Huang par jaanch shuru
items.detail: Nvidia board ne CEO Jensen Huang par swatantra jaanch shuru ki — aarop hai ki ve ek mahila ke sampark me the jise America cheeni jasusi se jodta hai; Huang ne staff ko patra me sambandh sweekara, board ko abhi koi raaz leak hone ka saboot nahi mila, ve CEO bane rahenge.
items.exam_angle: AI chip niryat niyantran aur America-China tech takraav — arthvyavastha aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Giza: Train takkar me 7 ki maut, 112 ghayal
items.detail: Giza ke Al-Ayyat jile me Giza-Fayoum train peeche se Cairo-Aswan train se takrayi, ek train patri se utri; swasthya mantralaya ke mutabik 7 ki maut, 112 ghayal, 45 ko aspatal se chhutti; Rashtrapati Sisi ne jaanch ka aadesh diya. (Updated: pehle 64 ghayal bataye gaye the, maut ki pushti nahi hui thi.)
items.exam_angle: Rail suraksha aur haadsa prabandhan — parivahan aur shasan ke liye mahatvapurna.
